game.core.rules.readable.title: Creature Conditions
game.core.rules.readable.summary: Conditions are recorded creature states whose active definitions can alter d20 tests and other supported outcomes until the condition changes or ends.

blocks.heading: Condition state
blocks.body: Applying, replacing, or removing a condition writes typed state. Later checks and saves consume only the effects declared by the active condition definition and mechanic.

blocks.heading: Exhaustion has levels
blocks.body: Exhaustion is recorded with its current level; the interface does not infer a level from descriptive text.

examples.title: A condition affects a test
examples.body: When a condition declares a relevant d20-test effect, the state-effects mechanic includes it while resolving the test.

citations.locator: Rules Glossary > Conditions and Exhaustion, PDF pp. 179-183
